237	export async function streamAiChat(
238	  messages: AiMessage[],
239	  system: string | undefined,
240	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
241	  signal?: AbortSignal,
242	): Promise<string> {
243	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
244	    method: 'POST',
245	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
246	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
247	    signal,
248	  })
249	  if (!res.ok) {
250	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
251	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
252	  }
253	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
254	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
255	  let buffer = ''
256	  let fullContent = ''
257	
258	  while (true) {
259	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
260	    if (done) break
261	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
262	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
263	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
264	    for (const line of parts) {
265	      const trimmed = line.trim()
266	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
267	      try {
268	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
269	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
270	          fullContent += event.content
271	          onChunk(event.content)
272	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
273	          fullContent = event.content
274	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
275	          throw new Error(event.error)
276	        }
277	      } catch (e) {
278	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
279	        throw e
280	      }
281	    }
282	  }
283	  return fullContent
284	}

571	export async function streamProjectChat(
572	  projectId: string,
573	  conversationId: string,
574	  message: string,
575	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
576	  signal?: AbortSignal,
577	): Promise<string> {
578	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/projects/${projectId}/conversations/${conversationId}/send`, {
579	    method: 'POST',
580	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
581	    body: JSON.stringify({ message }),
582	    signal,
583	  })
584	  if (!res.ok) {
585	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
586	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
587	  }
588	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
589	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
590	  let buffer = ''
591	  let fullContent = ''
592	  while (true) {
593	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
594	    if (done) break
595	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
596	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
597	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
598	    for (const line of parts) {
599	      const trimmed = line.trim()
600	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
601	      try {
602	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
603	        if (event.type === 'chunk') { fullContent += event.content; onChunk(event.content) }
604	        else if (event.type === 'done') { fullContent = event.content }
605	        else if (event.type === 'error') { throw new Error(event.error) }
606	      } catch (e) { if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue; throw e }
607	    }
608	  }
609	  return fullContent
610	}
